Together, @official_naver, NVIDIA, and @Brookfield are expanding Korea’s national AI factory buildout to fuel Korea’s startups and industries at gigawatt-scale. NAVER is deploying the NVIDIA DSX platform to deliver full-stack, lowest-cost AI factory infrastructure.
